substeps.caption: The lab's LECO PX500, as in its SOP videos: six Bakelite mounts in the 6-position holder; a 12 in platen.
A 320-grit SiC paper on the platen (by hand in the SOP; by the arm on a tray).
Head down, water on. The SOP's grinding step: head 35 rpm, force 30, platen 150 rpm, 30 s.
Head up and rinse; then 400, 600, 800 and 1200 grit, a fresh paper each time.
The final polish: a white cloth on the platen, for 1 um alumina suspension.
Head down, suspension from a dispenser (squeezed from a bottle in the SOP): force 3-5, 150 rpm, 3 min.
Done: the head lifts; the mounts are rinsed at the sink and dried. On a tray it needs water, a drain and air.
